common.heroText: Looking for a side job, an internship, or wondering what interesting job offers your region has for you? Then you are in the right place. StuJo is your platform for side jobs, internships and permanent positions in Schleswig-Holstein. We connect you with the employers around you.

Layout.footer_about_text: StuJo is the career portal for students in Schleswig-Holstein, represented in particular at the university locations Kiel and Flensburg. Beyond that we naturally also offer job postings from other federal states to local students.

forEmployers.title: For employers
forEmployers.intro: StuJo is a career portal for students in Kiel and Flensburg, giving employers the opportunity to connect with tomorrow's skilled professionals early on and attract them to their organization. Whether a working student position, internship, or first permanent role – StuJo covers the full range of opportunities. Your job offer is visible on all StuJo portals for up to eight weeks.
